function.name: search_holy_books
function.description: Search content, chapters or authors of holy books. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

book.description: The name of the holy book.

chapter.description: The chapter number, if relevant. Default: 3

content.description: Specific content to look for, if relevant.

message.content:
A **holy book** (also called a sacred text) is a written work that is considered divine, authoritative, or spiritually significant within a particular religion or faith tradition. These texts are often regarded as containing revelations from a deity, moral teachings, laws, histories, or guidance for worship and daily life. Holy books can serve various purposes:

| Purpose | Typical Content |
|---------|-----------------|
| **Revelation** | Direct words or messages from a deity or divine source. |
| **Law & Ethics** | Codes of conduct, commandments, or moral principles. |
| **History & Narrative** | Stories of creation, prophets, or foundational events. |
| **Liturgical Guidance** | Prayers, rituals, and liturgical instructions. |
| **Spiritual Insight** | Teachings on the nature of the soul, afterlife, or ultimate reality. |

Examples of holy books include the Bible (Christianity), the Qur’an (Islam), the Vedas (Hinduism), the Torah (Judaism), the Tripitaka (Buddhism), and many others. Each tradition views its holy book as a primary source of truth and authority, often guiding both individual practice and communal norms.
